Now it’s highly censored; too much cleavage or a thong will give a “nudity” error message. That’s not a bad thing but I can do that on anything and I’m not interested in dancing cats. It only allows 2 images at a time so if you’re trying to get the best accuracy, this isn’t the best solution. If you’re trying to reposition a person in a photo, it’ll probably change their facial appearance and you’ll probably have extra fingers or a stray extra arm or 2 left feet. That’s when the 40 image limit becomes problematic because it’ll take 10 images to correct the app’s error on one photo. I’m 4 weeks into using the app and now I’m just experimenting to see if there’s anything I can use it for. Probably not.

reviews.title: Bait-and-switch — lifetime unlimited turned into 40-per-week limit
reviews.text:
I paid for Lifetime Pro Access with unlimited usage as a one-time purchase. The developer unilaterally changed the terms after purchase and capped me at 40 images per week — no notice, no consent, no explanation.

"Restore Purchase" confirms I am a Pro Member, but the weekly limit remains. They still sell "Unlimited Pro" to new customers at higher prices — so the feature exists, they just won’t honour it for lifetime buyers.

I’ve contacted support repeatedly over more than a week, sent a formal final notice — and they have not replied or resolved anything. If you’re considering a lifetime deal, be very careful — they appear to change the rules after you pay.

Reported to CMA and Trading Standards for deceptive practices.

reviews.title: STAY AWAY
reviews.text:
I very rarely write negative reviews, but this experience has left me with no choice.
I purchased the Lifetime Pro Membership, and according to Parrot AI’s own development team, this should give me access to create videos. Unfortunately, I still cannot create any videos because the platform keeps telling me that I have no credits.
I contacted customer support immediately. They asked me to provide all of my purchase details, receipts, and account information, which I sent without delay. After that… complete silence. No updates, no resolution, no explanation.
Paying for a lifetime subscription and then being unable to use one of its core features is frustrating enough, but being ignored by support after providing everything they requested is completely unacceptable.
I am not someone who normally writes reviews, but this level of customer service is simply appalling. I sincerely hope Parrot AI improves both its support and the way it handles paying customers.

reviews.title: Lifetime Pro Access
reviews.text: I got in early with this app and bought the lifetime Pro Access thinking I would have access to all the available tools. At one point, I had a huge issue with them trying to charge my card to “renew”, only finding out because I used a card that was no longer valid for the initial purpose. It took quite a while to get that straightened out, but I finally had the pro access reinstated. It was a pain, but I do have to commend the customer service people I dealt with for trying really hard to make things right and always being responsive and helpful - so 5 stars for them. The reason for the 2 star review is that since then, new features have been added that I can’t access without buying credits. People who got in on the app early on and paid for lifetime access to the pro features should get access to everything that gets added - it was the selling point they used when I first started using it.

reviews.title: Bait and Switch.
reviews.text:
I initially signed up for this on a one week trial basis. During which time there is an option to create your own template. This allows you to use photos from your own photo library, and put a celebrity or generic voice over it. This was extremely handy and exactly what I was looking for! I decided to upgrade to a lifetime subscription as I intended to use this quite a bit. However, when I did so everything that I had previously was gone, and there was no option for a create your own template, nor was there any reference to it. I contacted customer service multiple times, was essentially ignored and/or the AI generated response said we are sorry we know how important that it is. We don’t understand why it’s not working.  After several days, I got frustrated and asked for a refund from the App store. Upon their review and the proclivity of this happening, they immediately refunded a lifetime subscription. 
Due to poor customer service, the inability to get an answer and/or the product that I paid for I cannot recommend this in good faith.  
Use caution, I believe that this is a bait and switch tactic in full use.
